summary: Iteration 3 verified the two new features end-to-end: (1) AI-generated vehicle images via Gemini Nano Banana, and (2) rider tipping. BACKEND (pytest, 10/10 PASS — /app/test_reports/pytest/iter3_vehicle_tip.xml): GET /api/vehicle-image returns 200 with {image,cached} for both fresh and cached desc; case+whitespace are normalized into the same cache key; empty desc => 400; unauthenticated => 401. First call to 'Silver Toyota Camry' generated a real data:image/...;base64 PNG and the second call returned cached:true in <5s (the Emergent LLM key budget was NOT exhausted this run). POST /api/rides/{id}/tip correctly returns 400 with message 'You can tip during the trip or after it\'s completed.' for statuses searching and driver_enroute, returns 200 {tip:5.0} during in_progress, supports re-tipping (last-write-wins 5.0 -> 7.5), 404 for unknown ride, 401 unauth. GET /api/rides/{id}/track now includes 'tip' and 'final_fare' fields. FRONTEND (Playwright on the live preview URL with the seeded customer rider@getaride.com / Ride1234): logged in -> chose preset destination -> created ride -> on /ride/[id] offers screen 3/5 offers rendered each with a real AI Camry/Accord thumbnail to the left of the fare+Accept (testID offer-vehicle-<id>); accepted first offer -> tracking sheet shows track-vehicle image on the right of the driver row and the driver row contains NO '$' price text (verified by reading innerText: 'Aisha Reed | Silver Toyota Camry · FL 998A | 4.8'); ~30-40s later in_progress reached and TipSection rendered with all chips tip-3, tip-5, tip-10, tip-custom, tip-0 plus 'Add a tip' / '100% goes to your driver'; tapping tip-5 showed 'Tip added: $5.00'; toggling tip-custom revealed tip-custom-input + tip-custom-apply, entering 4 + Add showed 'Tip added: $4.00'; trip auto-completed and CompletedSheet showed fare + '+$4.00 tip · Total $2715.00' line and the TipSection still rendered. No red screen / no JS errors thrown; only pre-existing RN-Web cosmetic deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) — already reported in iteration_1/2. Note: geolocation fell back to Iowa in headless (fare ~$2711) — confirmed in the request to NOT flag as bug.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Carry-over. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts shadow/shadowSoft.
Console warning still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Carry-over.

action_items: (carry-over) Replace shadow*/pointerEvents props with cross-platform style equivalents in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.

(optional/cosmetic) In CompletedSheet on /app/frontend/app/ride/[id].tsx the long pickup label 'Council Bluffs, Iowa 51501, United States → Orlando Intl Airport (MCO)' wraps to 2 lines when geolocation falls back to a non-Orlando IP — consider clamping to numberOfLines={2} and ellipsizeMode='tail' for tidiness (already truthful, not a bug).
critical_code_review_comments: generate_vehicle_image() swallows ALL exceptions and returns None — good for graceful degradation, but consider distinguishing rate-limit vs. transient errors so they aren't both cached as None forever (currently cache stores only successful images, so a transient failure correctly retries on next call — this is fine).

POST /api/rides/{id}/tip does not check that the caller is the ride's customer — any authenticated user who knows a ride_id could currently overwrite the tip. Low risk given UUID ride ids but worth a customer_id guard.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded customer rider@getaride.com / Ride1234 plus TEST_-prefixed users created by the pytest fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest from /app with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL set; conftest fixture reuses session. Both new endpoints (/api/vehicle-image and /api/rides/{id}/tip) and all related testIDs (offer-vehicle-<id>, track-vehicle, tip-3/5/10, tip-custom, tip-custom-input, tip-custom-apply, tip-0, tip-confirm) are wired and working. To exercise tipping via UI: login as rider, accept any offer, wait ~30-45s for in_progress; trip auto-completes around 85s after select. Vehicle image generation now succeeds for 'silver toyota camry' and 'black honda accord' (cached in mongo 'vehicle_images').
rca_of_issue: N/A — both new features pass functional and integration checks.
